messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH severity page fired -> service: inference-api-hosted; symptom: p99/p95 latency SLO burn in eu-west (thresholds crossed). Link: https://redwood-console/alerts/5332109999 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Incident #INC-2026-443: triggered by latency-slo-alert (eu-west). Auto-page to oncall rotation. Escalation policy: 3m -> 8m -> ops-lead.

Maya R: acked. I'm on it, pulling dashboards.

Jonas K: thanks — I'm jumping in for infra checks (autoscaler & sidecar throttles).

Priya S: quick question — is this all models or specific route? Console shows model-route `/v1/generate` high tail.

Maya R: looks like hosted-gen, all regions show small spike but eu-west is worst. p95 jumped from 120ms -> 760ms and p99 to ~2.1s. Error rates stable.

Samir L: could be hotkey / kvcache eviction. I'm checking KV miss rate.

Maya R: running prometheus queries now:
```
sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{region="eu-west",route="/v1/generate"}[1m])) by (le)
```

Maya R: KV cache hit ratio for replicas dropped from 0.93 -> 0.52 last 6m.

Jonas K: autoscaler logs show scaling attempts but new nodes stuck in pending for ~2m due to quota.

Priya S: can we temporarily route eu-west traffic to dedicated pool in us-east as fallback? latency might increase but avoids p99 blowouts.

Maya R: good idea. Options: 1) enable cross-region failover policy 2) force-route by tag -> dedicated-pool-1 3) reduce batch windows to lower tail. Which first?

Samir L: reducing batching is fast (sidecar flag), will lower throughput but helps tail. I can flip that in staging -> prod quickly.

Jonas K: quota request in cloud console is taking too long; fallback to route is faster. I'll prepare route: `route-policy: eu-west -> us-east-dedicated` (canary 10%).

Maya R: if canary is fine, we can ramp to 50% in 3m. Priya, can you approve failover?

Priya S: approve. do it. :thumbsup:

Jonas K: applying route change now. command: `redwoodctl routes apply --policy-id dynamic-failover-eu-001 --canary=0.1`

pagerduty: Note: incident auto-escalation suppressed after ack by Maya R.

Maya R: canary applied. Monitoring metrics.

Samir L: rolling sidecar change for batching: `kubectl apply -f sidecar-config-reduce-batch.yaml` -> will take ~45s to rollout.

Maya R: seeing p95 drop to 420ms on canary traffic. overall p95 down to 580ms. Good trend.

Jonas K: bumping canary to 40% now. `redwoodctl routes update --policy-id dynamic-failover-eu-001 --canary=0.4`

Priya S: communication check: any customer-facing impact? Support says a small subset of long requests may have experienced >2s latencies. No errors or data loss.

Maya R: preparing concise blurb for status page: "Investigating elevated latency in eu-west; mitigation in progress via cross-region routing. No data loss, some requests may see increased latency."

Samir L: sidecar rollout finished. KV hit ratio slowly recovering.

Maya R: p99 now ~1.3s, p95 310ms. We're stableish.

Jonas K: can we keep route at 40% until autoscaler quota resolves? Also I recommend adding a temporary autoscale override (manual replica bump) on dedicated pool.

Priya S: agree. Jonas, please raise count by +3. Maya, do you want us to keep incident open or resolve after 30m stable?

Maya R: hold incident open for 30m of stable metrics. Jonas, bump done: `redwoodctl capacity set --pool dedicated-us-east-1 --replicas=+3` -> confirmed.

pagerduty: Incident #INC-2026-443 acknowledged by Maya R at 5332109999. Next escalation suppressed.

Priya S: thanks team. Quick post-incident action items: 1) investigate quota failure path & prefill spare capacity 2) KV cache eviction root cause 3) consider pre-warming cross-region routes for failover 4) update runbook with sidecar batch-reduction hack.

Maya R: noted. I'll file incident ticket with metrics + timeline. Handoff to Jonas for capacity follow-through; I'll rotate out in 15m.

Jonas K: taking owner for follow-up. I'll update thread with cloud quota request status and confirm route rollback plan.

Samir L: leaving a note — will dig into kvcache eviction logs (probable GC spike on 3 replicas).

Maya R: thanks. Paging summary for the handoff: cause: high KV miss + delayed scaling -> p99 spike; mitigation: cross-region canary routing + reduce batching + manual capacity bump; status: stable, monitoring.

Priya S: OK to close PD page once 30m stable and p99 < 1s for 10m?

Maya R: yes. I'll close when conditions met.

Jonas K: quirk — need to keep canary at 20% not 40% for customers requiring region affinity. I'll adjust after stable window.

Maya R: noted. next update in 10m.

--- 10 minutes later ---

Jonas K: cloud quota increased (requested increment approved). We can scale back canary after scaling finishes.

Maya R: p99 is ~890ms over last 10m, p95 260ms. I'm going to mark this as mitigated and keep incident open for 20m.

pagerduty: Automated note: Incident #INC-2026-443 status -> mitigated by oncall at 5332111700.

Maya R: handing off to Jonas for post-incident follow-up. I'm going offline for a break. Thanks everyone. :heart:

Jonas K: taking it. I'll create the follow-up ticket and link metrics.

Priya S: TY team.

Samir L: thanks.

Maya R: closing thread from my side unless something pops.
